text_en: Praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord , O my soul!
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 我的灵魂，你要赞美上主，

text_en: I will praise the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praises to my God all my life long.
text_cn: 在我一生，我要赞美上主， 一息尚存，我要歌颂天主。

text_en: Do not put your trust in princes, in mortals, in whom there is no help.
text_cn: 你们不要全心依赖王侯大臣， 也不要依赖不能施救的世人；

text_en: When their breath departs, they return to the earth; on that very day their plans perish.
text_cn: 他的气息一断，就要归于灰土， 他的一切计划，立刻化为乌有。

text_en: Happy are those whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord their God,
text_cn: 凡是以雅各伯的天主为自己扶助的人， 以上主天主为自己希望的，是有福的人！

text_en: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps faith forever;
text_cn: 上主创造了上天与下土， 海洋和其中的所有一切。 他持守信实，一直到永久。

text_en: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The Lord sets the prisoners free;
text_cn: 上主为被欺的人作辩护， 上主给饥饿的人赐食物， 上主使被囚的人得自由。

text_en: the Lord opens the eyes of the blind. The Lord lifts up those who are bowed down; the Lord loves the righteous.
text_cn: 上主开启瞎子的眼睛， 上主使伛偻的人直身， 上主爱慕那正义的人。

text_en: The Lord watches over the strangers; he upholds the orphan and the widow, but the way of the wicked he brings to ruin.
text_cn: 上主对旅客加以保护， 上主支持孤儿和寡妇， 上主迷惑恶人的道路。

text_en: The Lord will reign forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 愿上主永永远远为君王！ 熙雍！你的天主万寿无疆！
